AnswerWord.description: A word a page offers for an experiment's analysis being elsewhere, and what it does.
AnswerWord.title: AnswerWord

ElsewhereRow.description:
A person's answer that an experiment's analysis is elsewhere: the page's magenta flag
(magenta: "a person said so").

actor.description: Who said so, under the machine's decider name.
actor.title: Actor

read_by_run.description: Whether this run read the answer; only then is the experiment off the list of no analysis found.
read_by_run.title: Read By Run

said.description: The words a page shows beside the flag.
said.title: Said

said_now.description: Whether the answer is in force in the Record now; differs from read_by_run while a change waits for the next re-run.
said_now.title: Said Now

ElsewhereRow.title: ElsewhereRow

NoAnalysisRow.description: One experiment with raw acquisitions found and no analysis found in what was read.

analysed_elsewhere.description: What a person said of its analysis being elsewhere; null where nobody did.

analysis_files.description: Analysis files found by the engine in what was read (not every file that exists) in its folder.
analysis_files.title: Analysis Files

answer_target.description: The Record target an answer about its analysis being elsewhere is written to.
answer_target.title: Answer Target

raw_acquisitions.description: Raw acquisition files found by the engine in what was read (not every file that exists) in its folder.
raw_acquisitions.title: Raw Acquisitions

raw_followed.description: Raw acquisitions found by the engine in what was read (not every file that exists) followed by an analysis file found.
raw_followed.title: Raw Followed

reason.description: forgotten: the rest of its theme's raw data found is mostly followed by analysis; stopped: mostly not (a line of work that ended); null: neither, or themes not computed.
reason.title: Reason

reason_said.description: The reason, or why none is given, in plain words.
reason_said.title: Reason Said

result_tables.description: Results tables found by the engine in what was read (not every file that exists) in its folder.
result_tables.title: Result Tables

said.description: One sentence a page shows for it: no analysis found.
said.title: Said

share_of_raw_followed_by_analysis.description: The share of its raw acquisitions found followed by an analysis file found.
share_of_raw_followed_by_analysis.title: Share Of Raw Followed By Analysis

theme_label.description: The words of its theme, beside the theme's number; null where it has none.
theme_label.title: Theme Label

theme_rest_share.description: The share of the rest of its theme's raw acquisitions found followed by analysis; null where it has no theme or no other experiment of its theme is judged.
theme_rest_share.title: Theme Rest Share

NoAnalysisRow.title: NoAnalysisRow

Thresholds.description: The completeness settings the response was computed under (``completeness.*``).
Thresholds.title: Thresholds

description:
The experiments with raw acquisitions found and no analysis found in what was read.

The list never says "never analyzed", because what the engine did not find may exist elsewhere.

answered.description: Experiments that would be listed, but a person said their analysis is elsewhere and this run read the answer: shown as answered.
answered.title: Answered

judged.description: Experiments with enough raw acquisitions found to be judged (completeness.judged_from_acquisitions): the list's denominator.
judged.title: Judged

title: NoAnalysisResponse
